'Eyes: AER recurved, PER slightly recurved and wider.' then the quoted eye sentence, then 'Legs with annuli.', two leg-length pieces beginning 'Length of legs: I 4.57 (1.23, 0.34, 1.19, 1.08, 0.73), ...', 'Tibial spine formula: 2-2-2-2.', 'TmI 0.58 and TmIV present.' and 'Opisthosoma 1.69 long, 1.13 wide, all other characters same as in male, except darker in color (Fig. 1C, D).', which refers the female's remaining characters to the male Description (male eye-arrangement sentence 'AER recurved, PER slightly recurved and wider.'; no eye-colour sentence in either sex). Both entries: 'locality: Gele Mountain National Forest Park', 'county: Shapingba District', 'stateProvince: Chongqing', 'verbatimElevation: 590 m', 'year: 2025', 'month: 1', 'day: 5', 'samplingProtocol: handpicking and sieving leaf litter', 'habitat: subtropical evergreen broad-leaved forests', 'recordedBy: Luyu Wang, Muhammad Irfan, Muyan Nan, Xiangyun Zhang'. The paratype range 02~05 holds one male and three females and does not say which code is the male; the female Description heading assigns SWUC-T-LIN-41-02 to the measured female. Methods: 'Eye sizes were measured at the maximum dorsal diameter.', 'Leg measurements are shown as total length (femur, patella, tibia, metatarsus, tarsus).' and 'All measurements are in millimeters.' Family Linyphiidae.

'Carapace 0.98 long, 0.83 wide, cephalic region slightly elevated, yellowish grey, fovea, cervical and radial grooves distinct (Fig. 1C, D).' (read in two pieces) 'Clypeus 0.19 high.' 'Chelicerae with 4 promarginal and 4 retromarginal teeth.' 'Sternum longer than wide, black with light patches and microsetae.' 'Eyes: AER recurved, PER slightly recurved and wider.' then the quoted eye sentence, then 'Legs with annuli.', two leg-length pieces beginning 'Length of legs: I 4.57 (1.23, 0.34, 1.19, 1.08, 0.73), ...', 'Tibial spine formula: 2-2-2-2.', 'TmI 0.58 and TmIV present.' and 'Opisthosoma 1.69 long, 1.13 wide, all other characters same as in male, except darker in color (Fig. 1C, D).', which refers the female's remaining characters to the male Description (male eye-arrangement sentence 'AER recurved, PER slightly recurved and wider.'; no eye-colour sentence in either sex). The paper does not say how the female was matched to the male beyond the shared locality, date and collectors. The male holotype's eye sentence (AME 0.06, ALE 0.10, PME 0.08, PLE 0.09) is filed separately. Type material, as printed in the Darwin Core 'Materials' block of the article preview page: Holotype: 'individualCount: 1', 'sex: Male', 'lifeStage: adult', 'institutionID: SWUC-T-LIN-41-01'; Paratype: 'sex: 1 Male, 3 females', 'lifeStage: adult', 'institutionID: SWUC-T-LIN-41-02~05' (no individualCount field). Both entries: 'locality: Gele Mountain National Forest Park', 'county: Shapingba District', 'stateProvince: Chongqing', 'verbatimElevation: 590 m', 'year: 2025', 'month: 1', 'day: 5', 'samplingProtocol: handpicking and sieving leaf litter', 'habitat: subtropical evergreen broad-leaved forests', 'recordedBy: Luyu Wang, Muhammad Irfan, Muyan Nan, Xiangyun Zhang'. The paratype range 02~05 holds one male and three females and does not say which code is the male; the female Description heading assigns SWUC-T-LIN-41-02 to the measured female. Subsection headings of the species account, in order: Materials, Description (bold labels Male, Palp, Female, Epigyne inside it), Diagnosis, Etymology, Distribution. Diagnosis (read in seven pieces) compares the paracymbium, lamella characteristica, cymbial apophysis and the ventral plate of the epigyne with D. socialis and has no eye wording. Outside the Descriptions and Methods the word eye appears only in the Methods abbreviation list ('AER—anterior eye row; ALE—anterior lateral eyes; AME—anterior median eyes;' and 'PER—posterior eye row; PLE—posterior lateral eyes; PME—posterior median eyes;'). Methods: 'Eye sizes were measured at the maximum dorsal diameter.', 'Leg measurements are shown as total length (femur, patella, tibia, metatarsus, tarsus).' and 'All measurements are in millimeters.' Family Linyphiidae.

method: measurement of the type specimen as listed in the male holotype Description under 'Eye diameters and interdistances'; no Methods sentence on eye measurement and no printed units (millimetres inferred from magnitude and Fig. 7 scale bars)
conditions: Male holotype LJ202369, the specimen the quoted sentence measures (Description heading 'Male holotype (Fig. 7A).'). Type materials, read in pieces: 'Holotype • ♂ (CBEE, LJ202369), China: Hubei Province: Xianning City, Chongyang County, dark zone of Daquan Cave,' + ' 29.5534°N, 114.2662°E, elevation: 124 m, 31.X.2023, Jian Chang, Mian Wei, Guoyuan Zhang and Haosiyi Zhu leg.' 'Paratypes: • 3♂♂3♀♀(CBEE, LJ202370–LJ202375), same data as holotype; • 4♂♂5♀♀(CBEE, LJ202376–LJ202384),' + ' China: Hubei Province: Xianning City, Xianan District, dark zone of a nameless cave,' + ' 29.7715°N, 114.3122°E, elevation: 89 m, 10.XII.2023, Jian Chang, Guolong Huang and Mian Wei leg.' No juveniles listed. Methods: 'Specimens studied here were collected from Hubei province, China, on 31 May 2023.' (conflicts with the printed type dates 31.X.2023 and 10.XII.2023; unresolved); 'All specimens were examined using an Olympus SZX7 stereomicroscope.'; 'Measurements were taken exclusively from the left structures (e.g., pedipalps, legs).' (eyes not named). No Methods sentence says how eyes were measured and no units are printed for any body or eye measurement. conditions: Spiricoelotes zhengi sp. nov., male holotype LJ202385. Type materials, read in ten pieces: 'Holotype • ♂ (CBEE, LJ202385), China: Hubei Province: Xianning City, Chongyang County, entrance of Daquan Cave, 29.5534°N, 114.2662°E, elevation: 124 m, 31.X.2023, Jian Chang, Mian Wei, Guoyuan Zhang and Haosiyi Zhu leg. Paratypes: • 2♂♂4♀♀(CBEE, LJ202386–LJ202391), same data as holotype; • 1♀(CBEE, LJ202392), China: Hubei Province: Huangshi City, Daye County, entrance of East Cave, 30.1800°N, 115.1043°E, elevation: 174 m, 26.XI.2023, Jian Chang, Hailun Chen, Jie Liu, Zhuoning Liu and Mian Wei leg.; • 1♀(CBEE, LJ202393), China: Hubei Province: Huangshi City, Daye County, West Cave, 30.1789°N, 115.1027°E, elevation: 165 m, 26.XI.2023, Jian Chang, Hailun Chen, Jie Liu, Zhuoning Liu and Mian Wei leg.; • 3♂♂3♀♀(CBEE, LJ202394–LJ202399), China: Hubei Province: Xianning City, Xianan District, entrance of a nameless cave, 29.7715°N, 114.3122°E, elevation: 89 m, 10.XII.2023, Jian Chang, Guolong Huang and Mian Wei leg.' (West Cave is printed without 'entrance of'); no juveniles listed. Subsections: Type materials, Etymology, Diagnosis, Description, Variation, Distribution. Male Description, in order: 'Male holotype (Fig. 7C).' 'Carapace yellowish, cervical and radial grooves indistinct, with weak patterns.' 'Chelicerae with 3 promarginal teeth and 5 retromarginal teeth, condyle weak.' 'Sternum longer than wide.' 'Abdomen dark, with 6 yellowish chevron-shaped patterns, covered by blueish gray hairs.' 'Legs yellowish.' 'Total length 6.82.' 'Carapace 3.43 long, 2.50 wide.' 'Abdomen 3.20 long, 2.16 wide.' then the quoted eye sentence (one sentence; returned in two pieces split after 'PLE 0.16;', and the publisher XML shows no tag or paragraph boundary inside it), then the leg measurements sentence 'Measurements of legs: I 13. 72 (3.83, 1.07, 3.66, 3.35, 1.81), ...' and 'Chelicera with 3 promarginal and 5 retromarginal teeth.' The female paratype (heading 'Female paratype (Fig. 7D).', no catalogue number) prints 'Same in abdominal patterns and chelicera teeth as male but in darker colour.' and 'Eye diameters and interdistances: AME 0.15, ALE 0.13, PME 0.17, PLE 0.15; AME–AME 0.07, AME–ALE 0.12, PME–PME 0.10, PME–PLE 0.10.' (filed separately, lines 49 to 52). Variation: 'The median apophysis present in some individuals as a small, sclerotized patch.' Diagnosis opens 'Spiricoelotes zhengi sp. nov. resembles S. zonatus and S. urumensis.' and has no eye word; Distribution 'Only known from the type localities (Fig. 8).' Introduction, read in two pieces each: 'Among these, six were discovered in caves (Chen et al. 2016); however, their large eyes and dark body coloration suggest that they are not truly troglobitic spiders.' (about the earlier cave-collected Spiricoelotes species) and 'The former inhabits the dark zones of caves and is characterized by reduced eyes and a pale body, which indicate its high adaptation to cave environments.' then 'In contrast, the latter resides at cave entrances and exhibits normal morphological traits and closely resembles S. zonatus.' (former = S. metyr, latter = S. zhengi). Methods (Morphological data) print 'All specimens were examined using an Olympus SZX7 stereomicroscope.' and 'Measurements were taken exclusively from the left structures (e.g., pedipalps, legs).' and define AME, ALE, PME, PLE as abbreviations only; no sentence says how eyes were measured. Methods (Specimen sampling) print 'Specimens studied here were collected from Hubei province, China, on 31 May 2023.', which differs from the type-material dates (31.X.2023, 26.XI.2023, 10.XII.2023); unresolved, as printed. Units: the paper prints no unit for any body or eye measurement (no 'All measurements are in mm' sentence; Methods give none); the only printed units are the figure scale bars, e.g. Fig. 7 (habitus) 'Scale bars: 1.00 mm.' and Figs 2, 5, 6 'Scale bar(s): 0.20 mm.' The value is read as millimetres by the arachnological convention and because body lengths of 6.70 to 7.89 match the habitus scale; this unit is an inference, not printed. Family Agelenidae.

'Abdomen 3.78 long, 2.30 wide.', then the quoted eye sentence, then 'Measurements of legs: ...' and the Epigyne label. The male holotype Description (referred to by the female's first sentence) has 'Carapace yellowish, cervical and radial grooves indistinct, with weak patterns.' and the male eye sentence 'Eye diameters and interdistances: AME 0.11, ALE 0.16, PME 0.16, PLE 0.16; AME–AME 0.08, AME–ALE 0.03, PME–PME 0.10, PME–PLE 0.09.' (filed separately). Neither eye sentence gives an ALE–PLE distance. No sentence on eye colour, eye rows or clypeus in either Description; the S. zhengi Diagnosis treats palp and epigyne only and does not mention eyes. Family Agelenidae.
